title: OZenful Thai Lime Skillet
description: A citrusy and crisp post-workout Thai dish featuring genmaicha and cooked in a cast-iron skillet without onion or garlic for a no-onion-no-garlic-friendly meal.
instructions: Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium-high heat.
Add chicken breast and cook until golden brown, about 5 minutes per side. Remove from pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add lime juice and genmaicha tea leaves, stir to combine, cooking for about 2 minutes or until fragrant.
Return chicken to skillet with sauce, mix well and simmer for an additional minute or two to allow flavors to meld together.
Stir in fish sauce, rice vinegar, and sugar. Cook for another minute.
Serve hot with steamed vegetables if desired.
